# Shafin Imtiaz

> Full Stack Developer, AI/ML enthusiast, and Cybersecurity learner based in
> Dhaka, Bangladesh. Builds web applications, machine learning models, and
> IoT-based safety systems.

## About
Shafin Imtiaz is a Computer Science and Engineering student and full-stack
developer working primarily with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js,
Python, and Arduino. Focus areas include full-stack web development,
applied machine learning, cybersecurity fundamentals, and IoT-based smart
safety systems.

## Key pages
- Homepage (About, Skills, Projects, Contact): https://safin-portfolio.vercel.app/

## Notable projects
- Human Safety App — real-time emergency alert and guardian-mode safety web app (Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, MongoDB): https://github.com/shafinSI/human-safety
- Heart Disease Prediction — ML risk-prediction model comparing KNN and Gradient Boosting (Python, Scikit-learn): https://github.com/shafinSI/heart-disease-project
- AI Fire-Fighting & Human-Detection Rescue Robot — Arduino-based rescue robot with flame/ultrasonic sensors (Arduino, C++): https://github.com/shafinSI/AI-Fire-Fighting-Human-Detection-Rescue-Robot
